name: Waste Management: Technology, Policy & Practice
description: Introduction to waste management, waste as a policy challenge: framing and overview, policy evolution and institutional architecture in India, municipal solid waste governance and policy instruments, waste-to-energy and resource recovery transitions, biomedical waste (BMW): risk regulation and policy compliance, electronic waste (E-waste) and extended producer responsibility (EPR), plastic waste management and market-based policy approaches, battery waste and hazardous waste governance: circular economy lens, emerging waste streams and global governance, liquid waste and wastewater policy and governance, lifecycle assessment (LCA) and policy evaluation tools, sanitation policy, governance, and behavioral dimensions, waste, labour, and social justice, socio-technical perspectives in waste and sanitation systems, applied policy project: institutional or campus waste assessment.
